title: [Accessibility] Editor UI is extremely cluttered from screen reader POV
body:
### Tested versions

4.5-4.6.1

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19044) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (Intel Corporation; 27.20.100.9664) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1165G7 @ 2.80GHz (8 threads) - 39.84 GiB memory

### Issue description

Right now, the UI for both the project manager and the editor are really, really cluttered, at least from the screen reader POV, which makes actually using the editor more and more tedious the more complex the project becomes. This doesn't apply as much to the project manager because it's UI is simple.

For example, if I create a new project that is blank, and tab end to end, I see, in tab order (list items are the text NVDA speaks):

* menu bar
* 2D   toggle button  not pressed
* 3D   toggle button  pressed
* Script   toggle button  not pressed
* Game   toggle button  not pressed
* AssetLib   toggle button  not pressed
* Run the project's main scene.   toggle button  not pressed
* Pause the running project's execution for debugging.   toggle button  unavailable  not pressed
* Stop the currently running project.   button  unavailable
* No Remote Deploy export presets configured.   toggle button  unavailable  not pressed
* Play the currently edited scene.   toggle button  not pressed
* Play a custom scene.   toggle button  not pressed
* Enable Movie Maker Mode   toggle button  not pressed
* Renderer: Forward+   toggle button  not pressed
* tab control. Scene   tab
* Add/Create a New Node.   button
* Instantiate a scene file as a Node. Creates an inherited scene if no root node exists.   button
* Filter Nodes   edit  Filter Nodes  blank
* Extra scene options.   toggle button  not pressed
* Favorite Nodes   toggle button  not pressed
* 2D Scene   button
* 3D Scene   button
* User Interface   button
* Other Node   button
* tab control. FileSystem   tab
* Go to previous selected folder/file.   button  unavailable
* Go to next selected folder/file.   button  unavailable
* Path   edit  res://
* Change Split Mode   button
* Filter Files   edit  Filter Files  blank
* Sort Files   toggle button  not pressed
* Directories   tree view. res://   data item  res://
* Drag to resize   separator  0
* tab control. [empty]   tab  selected  1 of 1
* Add a new scene.   button
* Show Opened Scenes List   toggle button  not pressed
* Toggle distraction-free mode.   toggle button  not pressed
* The 3D editor is not accessible at this time. Transform Mode   toggle button  pressed
* Move Mode   toggle button  not pressed
* Rotate Mode   toggle button  not pressed
* Scale Mode   toggle button  not pressed
* Select Mode   toggle button  not pressed
* Show list of selectable nodes at position clicked.   toggle button  not pressed
* Lock   button  unavailable
* Group   button  unavailable
* Ruler Mode   toggle button  not pressed
* Use Local Space   toggle button  not pressed
* Use Snap   toggle button  not pressed
* Toggle preview sunlight.   toggle button  pressed
* Toggle preview environment.   toggle button  pressed
* Edit Sun and Environment settings.   button
* Transform   toggle button  not pressed
* View   toggle button  not pressed
* grouping
* View: Perspective   toggle button  not pressed
* tab control
* Notifications:   button  unavailable
* 4.6.1.stable   link
* tab control. Inspector   tab  selected  1 of 3
* Create a new resource in memory and edit it.   button
* Load an existing resource from disk and edit it.   button
* Save the currently edited resource.   toggle button  unavailable  not pressed
* Extra resource options.   toggle button  not pressed
* Go to previous edited object in history.   button  unavailable
* Go to next edited object in history.   button  unavailable
* History of recently edited objects.   toggle button  unavailable  not pressed
* button  unavailable
* text
* Open documentation for this object.   button  unavailable
* Filter Properties   edit  read only  Filter Properties  blank
* Manage object properties.   toggle button  unavailable  not pressed
* [Nothing announced here]
* Drag to resize   separator  420
* Drag to resize   separator  -420

To say this is quite overwhelming is a bit of an understatement. It's something I can get used to, for certain, but the problem is the exponential explosion when I start building something. For example, if I create a scene, the UI changes only slightly: a tree view appears after "Extra scene options.   toggle button  not pressed": "Tree view. Node3D   data item  Node3D". Now, to get to the inspector, I can either tab until I find it, or shift-tab which makes me navigate properties/sections/categories in reverse. To my knowledge, there is no way for me to jump between all the sections/panels of the UI. This becomes a problem if I attach a script to the Node3D object. In this circumstance, the script editor becomes the "main" focus, and I have to shift-tab to get to the inspector, and navigate everything in reverse to get to the "start" of the inspector so I can modify things.

I can think of a few ways of solving this problem:

1. We could revamp the UI so that everything is a tab at the top which you could move among different sections with control-tab/control-shift-tab. This is the lease preferred option, from my view, because it would radically change how people use the editor.
2. We can do what Surge XT does where you can navigate by region with control comma/control period. This would jump between all the panels in the editor and would be pretty neat. For example, when in the 2D/3D... Parts, control Period would jump you to the scene editor, control Period would go to the FS doc, etc. Control Comma would do the same in reverse.
3. We could do something like control-1 through control-0 to navigate each panel in sequence.

I'm sure there could be other alternatives here too that I haven't considered, but I like solution 2 the most.

### Steps to reproduce

Create a new project and navigate around. Add a scene and build a node tree and navigate it and edit it. Then attach a script... Things will become very cluttered very quickly.
